scope: Integrated measured-rail and motion-parameter source; firmware, SDK, profiles, native regressions
findings_resolved: Float32 measured rail cap matches separate MCU products and whole-step floor
Automatic return braking retains configured automatic speed/acceleration/jerk
Low-jerk centering handoff previews the first centering tick and both rail stopping envelopes
Geometry-only profiles preserve the hidden rail preference; explicit rail writes are not skipped on equal readback
limitations: Software tests do not certify physical motor performance or missed step detection
No v6 physical trial has run yet
Encoder/vision fusion is not controlling this trial
Homing seek/latch and spin/upright-fall recovery are fixed paths; low-level hardware/timing are outside the requested configuration scope
